citation.title: AI-Based Topology Optimization of Freehand Sketches
citation.authors: Enno Garrelts, Marco Huber, Daniel Roth, Hansgeorg Binz
citation.version_coded: Version of record metadata/abstract (full text inaccessible)

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract presents a neural-network tool that interprets design sketches and proposes force-flow structures, but gives no explicit comparison with a classical optimizer.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No comparative cost or speed is stated in the abstract.
claim.alternatives: The tool is described as reducing effort in conceptualizing lightweight designs, without a measured comparison (abstract).

notes: Abstract accessible via publisher and institutional repository metadata. Publisher PDF and Fraunhofer repository full text were blocked (403 / bot protection); no bot check was bypassed. The abstract does not specify a classical comparison; I-UNCLEAR is retained as the no-full-text title/abstract code.
